title: Genesis 7:11 — the fountains of the great deep burst open
summary: Genesis 7:11 in English with the Hebrew reference: in Noah’s six hundredth year, in the second month on the seventeenth day, the fountains of the great deep burst open and the floodgates of the sky opened. 'second month' and 'seventeenth day' are highlighted in colour.

text.text: 11 In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.

numbers.note: Noah’s age (six hundredth year of his life) when the flood began
seventeenth day of the second month
